newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PTT buys more natural gas from Exxon's Nampho.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT buys more natural gas from Exxon's Nampho.

text.p: State-run Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) said it would raise its natural gas offtake from Thailand's Namphong field to 95-130 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) from a current 65 mmcfd.
The Namphong field in north eastern Thailand is operated by Esso Exploration and Production Korat Inc, a Exxon Corp unit, and PTT Exploration and Production Plc (PTTEP), a PTT unit.
PTT said in a gas purchase agreement signed on Monday it would increase its lifting to 120-130 mmcfd within two years.
PTT said the additional gas from Namphong will replace about seven billion baht ($269.2 million) of diesel imports a year.
The Namphong gas is used for powering a 660 megawatt electricity plant in northeastern Khon Kaen province.
Namphong, which started gas production in 1990, has Thailand's largest potential gas reserves and a proven reserve of 395 billion cubic feet.
